author: The Spiffing Brit
description:
Today we return to the glorious golden age of Flash gaming to investigate Feudalism, a perfectly balanced 2007 strategy classic with absolutely no exploits whatsoever. Except, of course, for the bit where we completely break it.

Is Feudalism balanced? Probably not. Is it still one of the greatest Flash games ever made? Absolutely. Can we ruin it using strategy so cursed it belongs in a museum? Naturally.
